fields.title: Facebook page validation record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of one verdict per slug. One PAGE row per slug checked, one RUN_SUMMARY row per run, ERROR rows on failure. Facebook changes its payload without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The slug this record answers for.

_scrapedAt.title: Checked at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: fetch_failed or unexpected_error.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: The Facebook vanity slug, normalised out of whatever form was supplied.

exists.title: Exists
exists.description: Whether the slug resolves to a real page. Facebook answers HTTP 200 for missing pages, so this is derived from the payload tier, not the status code.

payloadTier.title: Payload tier
payloadTier.description: HOLLOW (~330 KB, no such page), REDUCED (~0.7-1.4 MB, page exists but Facebook withheld the post feed) or FULL (>=1.5 MB, header plus roughly ten posts).

postsAreTrustworthy.title: Posts trustworthy
postsAreTrustworthy.description: True only on a FULL payload. On REDUCED, postsInPayload is 0 even for pages that post daily, so a zero there means 'not sent', not 'not posting'.

payloadBytes.title: Payload bytes
payloadBytes.description: Size of the HTML Facebook returned, which is what the tier is derived from.

name.title: Page name
name.description: The page's real display name. Null when the slug does not resolve.

pageId.title: Page ID
pageId.description: Numeric Facebook page id, decoded from the base64 profile-section id.

expectedBrand.title: Expected brand
expectedBrand.description: The brand the caller said this slug should belong to; null when none was supplied.

brandMatch.title: Brand match
brandMatch.description: EXACT, STRONG, WEAK, MISMATCH, or UNKNOWN when no expected brand was given. MISMATCH means the slug is real but belongs to somebody else.

brandMatchScore.title: Brand match score
brandMatchScore.description: Share of the expected brand's meaningful tokens found in the page name, 0 to 1.

followers.title: Followers
followers.description: Follower count as an integer. Facebook abbreviates large counts, so 39M is reported as 39000000 and is approximate; followersLabel keeps what was actually rendered.

followersLabel.title: Followers label
followersLabel.description: The follower count exactly as Facebook rendered it, e.g. '39M followers'.

following.title: Following
following.description: How many profiles this page follows.

primaryCategory.title: Primary category
primaryCategory.description: First category Facebook lists for the page.

phones.title: Phones
phones.description: Public phone numbers from the contact section.

websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Public website links, unwrapped from Facebook's l.php redirect.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Public email addresses from the contact section.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.description: Public addresses from the contact section.

postsInPayload.title: Posts in payload
postsInPayload.description: How many feed stories this response carried. Read it together with postsAreTrustworthy.

slugsChecked.title: Slugs checked
slugsChecked.description: RUN_SUMMARY only: how many slugs the run looked at.

existing.title: Existing
existing.description: RUN_SUMMARY only: how many resolved to a real page.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.description: RUN_SUMMARY only: how many did not resolve.

brandChecked.title: Brand checked
brandChecked.description: RUN_SUMMARY only: how many slugs had an expected brand to compare against.

brandMismatch.title: Brand mismatches
brandMismatch.description: RUN_SUMMARY only: real pages that belong to a different brand than expected.

brandWeakMatch.title: Weak brand matches
brandWeakMatch.description: RUN_SUMMARY only: pages that matched the expected brand only partially and deserve a human look.

mismatchedSlugs.title: Mismatched slugs
mismatchedSlugs.description: RUN_SUMMARY only: up to 50 slugs flagged as belonging to someone else.

reducedPayloads.title: Reduced payloads
reducedPayloads.description: RUN_SUMMARY only: existing pages whose post feed Facebook withheld.

fullPayloads.title: Full payloads
fullPayloads.description: RUN_SUMMARY only: existing pages that came back complete.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per slug: does it exist, whose page is it, how big is it.

brandCheck.title: Brand check
brandCheck.description: Whether each slug actually belongs to the brand you expected.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: Public contact details for the pages that exist.
